result:
M11 round 1 **passes**, with two small fixes I made myself. Nothing was committed, and both servers are still running for the runner to stop.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Review | Pass. All tasks T131–T138 exist in the code. The M11 code was already in commit 5e41e68, so I reviewed it with `git diff 8f8e52d..HEAD`. No test ids lost; the colour check only finds the two token files. |
| Swagger | Pass |
| `./mvnw verify` | 188 tests, 0 failures |
| `ng build` | No warnings; initial bundle 603.87 kB raw, 150.30 kB compressed (limit 500 kB) |
| curl regression on a fresh database | 7 suites, 0 failed |
| Browser on the real stack | Pass: empty states, every page with the backend stopped and after restart, the full journey with a real plan start, E2E-M11-01 to -07, and the smoke tests of earlier milestones |

The only server errors and console errors happened while I had stopped the backend on purpose for the error-state test.

**Fixes:**
- **F1** – `frontend/src/app/layout/shell.component.scss`: a built-in Material style was overriding the sidebar animation. Collapsing the sidebar didn't animate at all, and the phone menu slid in over 400 ms, above the 300 ms limit. It now takes about 200 ms, and 0 ms when reduced motion is on.
- **F2** – `frontend/src/app/features/dashboard/dashboard-page.component.html`: on the dashboard's "Completed in the last 7 days" list, the date ran into the title ("Chapter B 88115Oct 15"). The date now sits on the right of the row, like the habit streak.

After both fixes I re-ran the build, the colour check and the affected browser checks.

**Not M11 issues, logged for later:**
- After a plan starts, the "has started" banner shows within seconds. The plan card only switches to "In progress" at the page's 30-second refresh. This dates from the first spec and is within what the test allows.
- The bullet for "Show text doesn't shift when the font loads" wasn't measured, because the browser tool can't measure layout shift.

One command was blocked: my first test run used `$?` to capture the exit code, and that was auto-denied. I re-ran it without that and it passed.

Everything is in `loops/verify/outputs/` (report: `M11-round-1.md`; results under `evidence/M11/round-1/`). I also updated `progress.md`, `state/handoff.md` and `state/verdict.json`. Screenshots are in `run-artifacts/playwright/`.
